output.reason: The brief is convincing because yield fell equally in the on-time EA round and the slow RD round, and the drop sits only in the merit tiers that were cut, while the unchanged Presidential and no-award tiers held steady; the catch is that the merit tiers are also exactly the files that went through the slow scoring step, and the analyst hasn't yet split the tiers by round to separate the two causes.
